headline: Sirajganj teacher dismissed for drinking alcohol at school
summary: The teacher's MPO (Monthly Pay Order) has also been suspended following allegations of intoxication and disorderly conduct on campus.
details: A teacher in Sirajganj has been dismissed from his position following allegations of drinking alcohol and creating a disturbance at school.
The authorities have also suspended his MPO (Monthly Pay Order), effectively cutting off his government-funded salary.
The action was taken after reports of the school premises being used for intoxication, which the authorities deemed a severe violation of professional conduct.
The dismissal serves as a warning to educational staff regarding the strict adherence to behavioral standards within academic institutions.

headline_marked: Man [[killed by mob beating]] after being accused of snatching
headline: Man killed by mob beating after being accused of snatching
summary: A youth was allegedly beaten to death by a crowd after being labeled a snatcher, highlighting the dangers of mob justice.
details: A youth was allegedly killed by a mob beating after being accused of snatching. The incident occurred when a crowd gathered and attacked the man based on the accusation.
The victim was reportedly beaten severely by the people present at the scene, leading to his death.
Local authorities are investigating the incident to verify the claims of the theft and the circumstances surrounding the killing.
This incident adds to a series of concerns regarding mob justice in the country, where suspects are often targeted without legal process.
